lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The Area 3 "No Service Rendered" entry states only that Medicaid-covered services required by the plan of care must be documented on the date(s) of service; it specifies no observation/look-back window. (A 7-day look-back appears elsewhere in the document, at Area 30 for the Patient Review Instrument, but that is a different audit area and is not applied to Area 3.)

coding_levels.label: Claim disallowed — no service rendered
coding_levels.definition: If the Medicaid-covered services provided, required by the plan of care, are not documented on the date(s) of service, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If the Medicaid-covered services provided, required by the plan of care, are not documented on the date(s) of service, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Medicaid-covered services required by the plan of care must be documented on the date(s) of service; if they are not, the claim is disallowed.

source.quote: If the Medicaid-covered services provided, required by the plan of care, are not documented on the date(s) of service, the claim will be disallowed.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Documentation requirements for this audit area are applied by date-of-service band: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(c) applies for services 05/25/18 and after, and 18 NYCRR § 494.4(b) applies for services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18.
This protocol, including this audit area, applies to service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.

Services provided and billed in accordance with the listed NYSDOH COVID-19 PHE guidance pertaining to ALP services will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.

source.quote: Services provided and billed in accordance with COVID-19 PHE guidance issued by the NYS Department of Health (DOH) pertaining to ALP services will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.
